title.narrative: Enhanced fair and effective labour migration policies and measures have influenced implementation at the regional and sub-regional level

description.narrative:
Enhancement of fair and effective labor migration policies and measures at the regional and sub-regional levels are crucial in the context of Asia, where there is a need to protect the rights of migrant workers and ensure their safe and secure working environments. The ILO has previously provided technical assistance in developing frameworks and guidelines to support labor migration governance, including the South Asia Qualification Reference Framework and the ASEAN Consensus on the Promotion and Protection of the Rights of Migrant Workers.
During the current biennium, the ILO's efforts aim to strengthen labor migration governance, protect migrant workers' rights, and promote safe and secure working environments for all workers in the region. The ILO supports the implementation of the ASEAN Consensus and other regional frameworks through policy dialogue, capacity building, and the sharing of good practices. Key activities include organizing annual roundtables on labor migration, supporting bilateral dialogues, and expanding the knowledge base on migrant worker resource centers. The ILO also plays a key role in the regional review of the Global Compact on Migration and contributes to the preparation of the Asia Pacific Migration Report 2024.
The primary beneficiaries of the ILO's intervention are migrant workers in the ASEAN region, particularly women migrants and those in precarious employment. Other target groups include regional employers' and workers' organizations, as well as member state governments. Key stakeholders involved in the strategy include regional institutions, civil society organizations, and social partners.
